description: Docs gap: the KV put page describes the payload only in prose ('Body should be the value to be stored… use multipart/form-data for metadata') with no Body Parameters section, so the generated request had no way to carry the value. Model the multipart form: a required `value` part (the byte sequence, up to 25 MiB) and an optional JSON `metadata` part, exactly as v0 did.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A byte sequence to be stored, up to 25 MiB in length.
Associates arbitrary JSON data with a key/value pair.
